name: Archive Courier
description: Privately delivers readable group archives. Newcomers can receive files automatically, and an authorized requester can send an archive to an eligible recipient.
dataStored: Per-scope member preferences for automatic files and temporary duplicate-delivery markers.

assistant.summary: Automatically sends at most one up-to-100-MiB archive document per format to new members, omitting the oldest messages when needed so the newest history fits.
useCases: Explain whether new members will receive archived group history.
Describe which participant arrival events trigger archive delivery.
Summarize archive delivery readiness and duplicate suppression.
prerequisites: The plugin must be enabled in the target managed scope.
Archive policy should include the target managed scope before members arrive.
Chat archiving must already have captured retained messages for the group.
The runtime must provide the scoped chat archive export helper.
limitations: The plugin does not replay or backfill archive data on join events.
Membership requests are ignored until WhatsApp reports that the user joined or was approved.

consoleOperations.description: Inspect archive delivery readiness
Check archive document sizes and coverage
Enable archive capture for this scope
Deliver the selected group archive to an eligible private recipient
Prepare archive capture when enabling the plugin

integrations.description: Adds a verified link to read the delivered chat online when browser links are enabled.
Verifies that an online archive link belongs to the connected Workspace.
